title: Tarragona like never seen before

title: Great excursion
text: A city with very well preserved Roman ruins and facing the sea.The driver and guide very good.
author: 224nacho

title: A historic day
text: Tarragona was the third destination of the pack of 4 routes that my husband gave me for Christmas, all with "Living Barcelona" and all with Pedro as guide-driver. Girona and Barcelona we loved and Tarragona was the most "historic" for the Roman ruins that Pedro took us to, including all those of the city, the tower of the Sciiuones, the Arch of Berà and the Mèdol quarry. A historic day and a guide to recommend!!
author: tate2021
